title: Korupun language - Wikipedia
text: Korupun (Korapun) is a Papuan language spoken in Yahukimo Regency, Highland Papua. Dialects are Korupun (Duram), Dagi, Sisibna (Gobugdua), Deibula, (Western) Sela.

title: Korapun-Sela in Indonesia people group profile | Joshua Project
text: The Korapun-Sela people live in the eastern highlands of Papua Province, Indonesia, primarily in Jayawijaya Regency near the upper reaches of the Erok River. They speak the Korupun-Sela language, part of the Trans-New Guinea family and are closely related to other Mek-speaking groups.
